decision: Keep the existing 250k specialist. Damage previews tied control on mean greedy wins; explicit Slippery removal did not improve either seed. No default representation change.
next_useful_step: Broaden exact public preview coverage and inspect matched Slippery decisions before committing to a larger feature-training experiment; retain a no-preview control.

protocol.ablation: Control receives 9 zero channels; damage receives known flag/scaled/log HP and Block deltas, with stack channels zero; stacks receives the identical damage features plus Slippery removed. Canonical graph is unchanged in every arm. All arms start with bitwise identical logits/value and matched sampling.

evaluation.primary: Final 50k validation greedy wins per seed and mean across two seeds; report per-seed matched differences. Sampled outcomes, boss HP remaining on losses, and player HP on wins are secondary.
evaluation.selection: No intermediate selection or early stopping. Parent remains an explicit reference. No test access or confirmatory claim.
evaluation.uncertainty: Exploratory fine-tuning pilot on repeatedly used validation cases and only two learner seeds. Not independent confirmation and not evidence about learning from scratch.

protocol.initialization: Copy every tensor from the same 250k rich-combat Vantom policy, including critic. Equal-size 9→48→1 action branch in each arm; only final projection is zero. Fresh Adam/action/shuffle RNG in every run. This is a warm-start experiment, not exact continuation of the old source.
protocol.preview_scope: Exact immediate enemy HP/Block/Slippery delta only where bounded native public reconstruction supports the action; unknown otherwise. No state-guard change.

limits: Two fine-tuning seeds, one inherited actor, repeatedly used42-case validation panel. No fresh-test or from-scratch claim.
Bootstrap intervals resample cases for a fixed pair of trained policies; they do not quantify across-seed model uncertainty. Sampled games share cases.
Conditional HP metrics must be compared on the same lost/won cases; raw group averages have changing composition.
Expensive low-damage flags indicate review opportunities, not proven mistakes: cards may have other useful effects.

stack_information.interpretation: Information diagnostic, not a learning outcome. Without Boot and with only supported ordinary Slippery damage events, HP damage plus starting Slippery determines consumed stacks. Explicit stack channels can still change learnability in a finite network/budget.
